_comment: REAL DSS2-red cutouts (CDS hips2fits) at SIMBAD-typed objects. Ground-truth label derived from SIMBAD otype. Pixels are an asinh display stretch (a=10, black=25th pct, white=max) quantized to 8-bit [0,255], mimicking the stretched HiPS JPEG tiles ImageViewer.sampleCutoutAt classifies; only genuinely flat-topped (DSS-saturated) cores plateau. -1 marks a gap (no coverage → NaN). Built by scratchpad/build_holdout.mjs (not committed).
